messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH GPU_QUEUE_GROWTH on prod-render (service: inference-runtime) — 95th queue depth > 120 for 6m. Paging oncall (rotation: infra-oncall) :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Pager details: alert_id=alert-8721, severity=pg, runbook=https://redwood/internal/runbooks/gpu-autoscale.md

sara: acked — looking

mike: on it. seeing a bunch of HPA events not firing + prometheus-adapter logs spiking with 429s to prometheus write path. quick check: `kubectl get hpa -n prod inference --show-events` shows no recent scale events.

cheng: same, dashboard shows GPU utilization at ~98% on nodepool-gpu-1 and request queue size growing. Customers on dedicated clusters hitting timeouts, our rate limiter started 503ing burst clients.

alex: adding context: we rolled prometheus-adapter 1.8.0 -> 1.9.0 yesterday as part of metrics hardening. adapter has a new batching/flush config that might be misbehaving under high scrape cardinality.

sara: exporting logs: `kubectl logs deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring --since=15m | grep \"429\" | head` shows adapter returning 429s from our metrics backend ~10:12:05 -> 10:16:30.

mike: prometheus itself looks healthy but pushgateway/TSDB remote_write is slightly delayed. adapter is showing `queue_full` errors in metrics. HPA uses custom metrics API via adapter -> if adapter is overloaded, HPA won't get metrics -> no scaling. pattern fits.

liz: customer impact: reported by 3 paying customers (IDs: cust-104, cust-208, cust-312). They see increased latency and failed requests when inference queues hit GPU capacity. CS already triaged and notified customers that we're investigating.

sara: immediate mitigation plan: 1) open manual scale of GPU pool to relieve pressure 2) restart prometheus-adapter to clear stuck batches 3) temporarily fallback HPA to CPU-based metric for inference-runtime so it can scale until adapter recovered.

mike: manual scale started: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize nodepool-gpu-1 --size 18` (was 12 -> 18). ETA tracking.

alex: I'm going to `kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring` to force adapter to pick new config and drain pending queue. Doing it in 30s.

cheng: note: restarting adapter will drop current custom metric availability for ~20-30s. HPA may briefly flail. we should coordinate to keep manual scaling in place.

sara: doing step 3: applying a temporary HPA patch to use `queue_length` (pod metrics) instead of custom metric. Patch applied: \n```\nkubectl patch hpa inference -n prod -p '{"spec":{"metrics":[{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","target":{"type":"Utilization","averageUtilization":50}}}]}}'\n```\n
mike: adapter restart done — pods back up. logs show backlog drain and fewer 429s. `kubectl logs` shows `flushed 1200 metrics in 3.2s` around 10:18.

cheng: nodepool resize reporting instance creation in GCE, starting to join cluster. new GPU nodes are coming up (kubelet registering).

sara: queue growth reversed after manual scale + adapter restart — queue depth down from 140 -> 30 within 6m. 95th latency dropping.

liz: customer update: CS posted interim update to affected customers noting mitigation steps and ETA for full root cause analysis.

alex: root cause hypothesis: prometheus-adapter's new batching flush interacts poorly with our high-cardinality custom metrics (per-model/per-tenant) causing backpressure to remote_write -> adapter returns 429 and refuses custom metrics queries -> HPA stalls. Need to validate with metrics and adapter team.

mike: next actions: 1) revert adapter to previous stable image (1.8.0) in canary first, 2) add circuit-breaker / throttling to the adapter remote_write path, 3) add alerting on adapter queue length and HPA fetch latency. I'll open PRs.

sara: filing incident ticket and assigning followups: incident/2376543210, severity=pg. Items: RCA (adapter batching bug), rollback plan, improved alerts, customer communication doc.

liz: noted. CS will send final incident summary once we have RCA and timeline.

incident-bot: Incident created: #2376543210 — prod GPU starvation due to metrics-adapter overload. Status: mitigated (manual scale + adapter restart).

mike: one more data point: `kubectl describe hpa inference -n prod` shows last metrics scrape 10:10, attempts failed 5x due to adapter errors. HPA last scaled 03:45 earlier.

cheng: follow-ups assigned: alex -> adapter rollback PR, mike -> monitoring/alerting changes, sara -> post-incident customer comms + runbook updates.

sara: thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread open for the RCA timeline. Closing pager for now. :white_check_mark:

alex: beginning rollback test in canary cluster, will report status in 30m.

mike: created alert: `AdapterQueueLength > 50 for 5m` to pager infra-oncall. Also added dashboard panel for HPA fetch latency.

liz: tagging account managers to prep customer outreach.

sara: last note — add a migration task to run a backfill for any custom metric samples lost while adapter was down so we don't create long-term drift in autoscaling heuristics.

incident-bot: #{2376543210} thread archived after 3h of activity.
